Welcome to
Grand Union Village School
Welcome to
Grand Union Village School
Together We Can
Welcome to Grand Union Village School, part of the Eden Academy Trust.
Grand Union Village School pupils attend one of two specialist sites. Our main site is the newly built Grand Union Village School in Hayes/Northolt, and some pupils attend our Eden Pinkwell Satellite provision, based at Pinkwell School in Hayes.
We are a primary school for children aged 4–11 with severe, profound and multiple learning disabilities, including autism, physical, sensory, and complex needs.
Grand Union Village School is a safe, welcoming community where pupils, families and staff work together to create an environment in which everyone is heard, understood and celebrated. This nurturing approach enables all to thrive, be challenged and achieve excellence.
We integrate education and therapy, with strong multi-professional teams working together to enhance each child’s learning experience.
We also offer a wide range of activities for pupils and their families, both after school and during the holidays, to support social development and extend learning opportunities.
Please explore our website to find out more, and feel free to contact us with any questions or to arrange a visit. You will be very welcome.
Melissa Barrowcliffe, Head of School

pageCache.text:
Grand Union Village School
Aims of our school
Aims of the school
At Grand Union Village School, we create a safe and welcoming learning community in which our pupils, families and staff contribute to creating a climate in which all are heard, understood and celebrated; enabling all to thrive, be challenged and achieve excellence.
The school aims to integrate education with therapy, providing a supportive environment that combines strong, multi-professional teams to enhance learning experiences.
Grand Union Village School is committed to offering a wide range of activities for pupils and their families, both after school and during holidays, to support social development and learning opportunities.
10 Golden Rules
Our Golden Rules are written from a child’s perspective and form the foundation of the ethos of our school:
Treat me with respect and dignity
Listen to what I have to say
Give me time to respond and interact in my own way
Let me know what's going to happen
Try to understand me, I can't explain my feelings
Talk to me, not about me
Allow me to make choices and decisions for myself
Stay calm with me even if I do not stay calm myself
Help me to stay safe
Telling me what I am good at builds my confidence

School uniform
We have made improvements to our school uniform ordering system. Uniform can now be ordered and paid for online through School Trends.
There are no minimum order quantities, and all items will be delivered directly to your chosen address.
In addition to our approved school uniform with logos, families can also purchase plain items such as trousers, skirts and shirts. Pupils are welcome to wear non-logo uniform in line with our uniform policy.
We also encourage families to use second-hand school uniform. Many good-quality pre-loved items are available at a reduced cost on many online shopping platforms.
If you need additional support please contact the school office.
Parent Pages
Our parent pages are where you can find many useful day to day tips and further information about Family Services.
